creatorsApi.requirements: Requires an approved Amazon Associates account with at least 10 qualifying sales in the trailing 30 days and server-side Creators API credentials configured in Cloudflare Pages secrets (AMAZON_CREATORS_CREDENTIAL_ID, AMAZON_CREATORS_CREDENTIAL_SECRET).

policyNote: Uses approved Amazon Associates tagged search URLs without scraping, fabricated ASINs, hardcoded prices, or locally copied Amazon product images. Expandable when Creators API access or approved direct product links are provisioned.
